subject.title: fix(web-search): align credential presence with usable providers

question: Should the security audit execute root-confined light public-artifact modules from installed external plugins to evaluate provider-owned configured credential hooks?
rationale: No concrete vulnerability was found and the loader is guarded, but accepting a new audit-time external plugin code-loading boundary requires repository-owner intent rather than automated correctness judgment.

options.title: Accept guarded light modules
options.body: Allow installed external provider light artifacts during audit to preserve runtime parity for custom configured credential fields.

options.title: Require metadata-only contracts
options.body: Reject audit-time external module execution and add manifest or Plugin SDK metadata describing provider credential fields.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded light modules
recommendation.body: Allow installed external provider light artifacts during audit to preserve runtime parity for custom configured credential fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and the merged feature commit connect this owner most directly to both the detector and public-artifact architecture.
